news.raw_snippet: The global screen industry is being reshaped by two significant forces: increasing international competition for production investment and the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI). Hollywood, long the centre of the global screen industry, faces growing competition from countries and jurisdictions offering more attractive conditions for international investment. At the same time, AI is transforming how screen content is developed, produced and distributed, enabling new efficiencies [...] The US industry's response has increasingly centred on consolidation. Driven by the economics of streaming and intensifying competition from lower-cost production locations, the past two years have seen a series of significant transactions among Hollywood's largest players, including Skydance Media's acquisition of Paramount in 2025. That trend culminated in October 2026 with the completion of Paramount Skydance's approximately USD $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a [...] Alongside heightened competition driven by production incentives, AI is a significant force of disruption in the screen industry. Major players including Disney, Warner Bros. Discovery, Paramount and NBCUniversal have established AI initiatives or governance frameworks, while Lionsgate has appointed a Chief AI Officer and entered partnerships with AI developers. ### Do I need previous experience in AI?

No. AI Product Management starts from the basics on the technical side and does not require previous experience in artificial intelligence or advanced programming knowledge.
